{{- /* Returns the display name of the page's top-level section: the main menu label when the section is in the menu (e.g. "Cloud"), otherwise its title. Used as the "section" filter for search. */ -}} {{- $fs := .FirstSection -}} {{- $name := $fs.Title -}} {{- range site.Menus.main -}} {{- if and .Page (eq .Page $fs) -}}{{- $name = .Name -}}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $name -}}
